chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0479: Ji Ning Awakens Sword Force Before the Final Confrontation
chapter_meta_description: In the Realm of Annihilation, Ji Ning unconsciously awakens Sword Force, a power beyond the Grand Dao of the Sword. The Mother Queens abandon their observation, and the Golden Cape General moves to capture him. The seven Fiendgods prepare for war.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0479: The Birth of Sword Force
og_description: Ji Ning unlocks a primordial sword power, but his captors have run out of patience.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 0479: The Birth of Sword Force
twitter_description: Ji Ning awakens Sword Force. The Mother Queens give the order. The Fiendgods prepare to fight. The siege breaks.

lore_anchors.definition: A power that naturally manifests at a Sword Immortal's blade when they fully master the Grand Dao of the Sword and seek its deeper essence. It sharpens the sword's edge and increases penetrating power. Ji Ning gains a sliver of it prematurely.

The eternally dark, storm-ravaged void between the Three Realms and the broader Chaosverse; it is featureless, devoid of Dao resonance, and forces cultivators to rely solely on physical arts and Heartforce for survival.
The collective title for the supreme ruler(s) of the Broken Horn World, a terrifying being who survived the ancient war against the Three Realms.
The alien realm from which the horned warriors and the Mother Queens originate, located beyond the Realm of Annihilation.
The commander of the First Army of the Broken Horn World, an Empyrean God-level combatant who has never been personally deployed until now.
A classical Xianxia divine ability that allows a cultivator to manifest extra limbs, exponentially increasing their close-quarters combat lethality.

cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a special power that normally only appears after fully mastering the Grand Dao of the Sword. Ji Ning gets a sliver early, showing his insane talent.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Mother Queens wait eighteen years to attack?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They were using Ji Ning's Heartforce leakage to analyze and deduce the secret of Heartforce themselves. Once his control became perfect, the data stream stopped, and capture became the only option.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Golden Cape General stronger than the violet-caped warriors?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes. The violet-caped warriors are described as pinnacle Celestial Immortal level, while the General is at the Empyrean God level—a full tier above.
